purpose: Substantive completion of the simulated review; exploratory new analyses
matched_moment_family: p=s(J,1,1,1,1); A J=0,2 with probabilities .25,.75; B J=1,3 with probabilities .75,.25
truth_integration: Graph occupancy truncation with explicit binomial tail bound; small-k independent exact check
near_tie: Two-edge star; p_center=1e-4, p_leaves=(1+-delta)*1e-4; delta=0,.02,.1,.5; depths=1000,10000
background: Vary graph abundance at fixed within-panel composition; contrast whole-transcriptome k and panel-only n; report selection coverage
phenotype: Author MMRStatus; one row per patient; fixed L2 logistic model; leave-one-patient-out CV with training-only standardization; compare mean abundance, R2, R500 and their increment; two-sided association and paired CV loss
phenotype_cohort: Previously analyzed 23 patients and expanded public atlas tumor epithelial cohort; overlapping, not independent validation
patient_eligibility: at least 100 epithelial tumor cells at all-gene L>=500; fixed eligible set across k
full_integrin_graph: 26 genes,24 curated heterodimers,2 tree components; require source-row presence
scalability: Sparse occupied-gene support, exact or explicitly bounded truncation; general flow solver; compare with the original closed-form integrin graph and independent LP
native_comparator: Already corrected: same actually converged patients in both halves, unprojected raw native outputs
